preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of friends N and roads M must satisfy the given constraints.
Each road must connect two valid friends and have a positive length.
The road number K must be within the range of available roads.

postconditions.description: The output must be formatted correctly with two space-separated values rounded to five decimal places.

postconditions.expression: max_dist == min(max(dist(i) for i in range(1, N+1)) for dist in distances)
postconditions.description: The maximum distance must be minimized according to the specified criteria.
The distance from point P to friend A must be within the length of the road.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= T <= 10","description":"The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10."},{"id":"P2","expression":"2 <= N <= 10**5 and N-1 <= M <= N*(N-1)//2","description":"The number of friends N and roads M must satisfy the given constraints."},{"id":"P3","expression":"1 <= A <= N and 1 <= B <= N and 1 <= C <= 10**9","description":"Each road must connect two valid friends and have a positive length."},{"id":"P4","expression":"1 <= K <= M","description":"The road number K must be within the range of available roads."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == f'{distance:.5f} {max_dist:.5f}'","description":"The output must be formatted correctly with two space-separated values rounded to five decimal places."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"max_dist == min(max(dist(i) for i in range(1, N+1)) for dist in distances)","description":"The maximum distance must be minimized according to the specified criteria."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"distance >= 0 and distance <= C","description":"The distance from point P to friend A must be within the length of the road."}],"invariants":[]}
